meta.description: Trip2World connects you with people around the world for spontaneous face-to-face conversations. Meet someone new in seconds.
meta.tagline: Meet the world, one conversation at a time.

common.networkError: We could not reach Trip2World. Check your connection and try again.

landing.subhead: Trip2World pairs you face to face with someone new, anywhere on earth. Talk as long as you like. Move on whenever you want.
landing.reassurance: Free to use · 18+ only · Your camera stays off until you choose to start
landing.countriesLabel: Countries you can meet people from

camera.title: Allow your camera
camera.body: One tap. Your video is peer-to-peer — it goes to the person you are talking to, not to a server.

matched.title: Get matched
matched.body: Choose a country, a language, or nothing at all. We find someone available and compatible.

next.title: Press Next any time
next.body: Not feeling it? One tap ends the call and finds someone new. No explanation needed.

landing.interestsTitle: Matched on what you actually care about
landing.interestsBody: Pick your interests and we will prioritise people who share them — without ever trapping you in a bubble.
landing.safetyTitle: Safety is not a feature we added later
landing.safetyBody: Talking to strangers only works if the rules are clear and enforced. Here is exactly what we do.

age.title: 18+ only, enforced
age.body: Every account is age-gated at signup. The minimum cannot be lowered by configuration.

report.title: Report in one tap
report.body: Reports go to a human moderation queue. Child-safety and threat reports jump the queue.

block.title: Block means never again
block.body: Blocking is permanent and mutual. You will not be matched with that person again.

recording.title: Conversations are not recorded
recording.body: We store who spoke to whom and when — never the video, audio, or what was said.

landing.guidelinesPrompt: Read the <link>Community Guidelines</link> before you start.

free.a: Yes. Matching, video, text chat, reporting and blocking are all free and always will be. Safety features are never behind a paywall.

recording.a: No. We keep metadata about a conversation — the participants, when it started, how it ended — so that abuse reports can be investigated. The conversation itself is peer-to-peer and is never captured.

details.a: The person you are matched with sees your username, and only the details you choose to share: country, an age range, languages, interests. Never your exact age, email, or location beyond the country.

next.q: What happens when I press Next?
next.a: The call ends immediately for both of you, and you go straight back into matching. You will not be paired with the same person again while other people are available.

mobile.q: Can I use Trip2World on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes — the web app works in a mobile browser and can be installed to your home screen.

landing.finalCta: Someone interesting is one tap away

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Trip2World needs your camera and microphone
PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Video chat cannot work without them. Click the camera icon in your browser's address bar and allow access, then try again.

NO_DEVICE.title: No camera or microphone found
NO_DEVICE.body: Connect a camera and microphone, then try again. If they are already connected, check they are enabled in your system settings.

DEVICE_BUSY.title: Your camera is being used by another app
DEVICE_BUSY.body: Close any other app using the camera — a video call, or another browser tab — then try again.

INSECURE_CONTEXT.title: This page is not secure
INSECURE_CONTEXT.body: Browsers only allow camera access over HTTPS. Open Trip2World using an https:// address.

UNSUPPORTED.title: This browser cannot do video chat
UNSUPPORTED.body: Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

OVERCONSTRAINED.title: Your camera does not support the required settings
OVERCONSTRAINED.body: We will try again with basic settings.

UNKNOWN.title: We could not start your camera
UNKNOWN.body: Something went wrong reaching your camera or microphone. Try again.

discover.leaveBlocked: End the conversation first — leaving this page hangs up.
discover.permissionsBody: Your browser will ask for permission. Nothing is shared until you start.
discover.readyBody: Hi {name} — press Start to meet someone new.
discover.connectingToServerBody: Waiting for the server to confirm your place in the queue.
discover.reconnectingToServerBody: We are not connected to the matchmaking server. Retrying — check your connection.
discover.aloneTitle: Nobody else is here right now
discover.aloneBody: You are the only person searching. Stay here and we will pair you the moment someone joins.
discover.partnerLeftBody: That happens — press Next to meet someone else.

cameraSwitch.title: Could not switch camera
cameraSwitch.body: The other camera is unavailable right now. It may be in use by another app.

disconnected.title: Cannot reach Trip2World
disconnected.body: We lost the connection to our servers. Retrying…

banned.title: Your account is restricted
banned.body: Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

controls.connectDeclinedSetting: That person is not accepting connection requests.

blockDialog.title: Block {name}?
blockDialog.body: You will never be matched with them again, and this cannot be undone from inside a call. The conversation ends now.

reportDialog.title: Report {name}
reportDialog.subtitle: The conversation will end and you will not be matched with them again.
reportDialog.detailsPlaceholder: Anything else our moderators should know? (optional)

settings.title: Settings
settings.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection.

profile.displayNameHint: What other people see. Leave blank to use your username.
profile.languageHint: The language Trip2World is shown in. Saved to your account, so it follows you between devices.

privacy.intro: These control what the person you are matched with can see. Your username is always visible so that reporting and blocking cannot be defeated.
privacy.showAgeBracketHint: A range such as 25–34, never your exact age.
privacy.allowConnectionRequestsHint: People you have talked to can ask to stay in touch.

matching.relaxationHint: We try these first. If nobody is available we widen the search rather than leave you waiting.
matching.autoRequeue: Find someone new automatically when a conversation ends
matching.startCameraOff: Start conversations with my camera off

blocked.emptyBody: Blocking someone means you will never be matched with them again.

account.signOutHint: Sign out on this device. Your account is unaffected.
account.deleteBody: Your account is deactivated immediately and permanently erased after 14 days. Signing in during that window cancels it. Reports you filed about other people are kept without any link to you — see <link>Privacy</link>.
account.scheduledTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
account.scheduledBody: It will be permanently erased on {date}. Signing in again before then cancels the request.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.loadFailed: Could not load your token balance.
tokens.purchaseSuccess: Payment received. Your balance updates within a few seconds.
tokens.buyUnavailable: Buying tokens is not available on this deployment yet.
tokens.disclaimer: Tokens have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn. Tips are final and cannot be refunded once sent. See the <link>Terms</link>.

connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: People you agreed to stay in touch with after a conversation.
connections.removeConfirmBody: You will both stop being connected. Either of you can send a new request later.
connections.emptyBody: During a conversation, use the connect button to ask someone to stay in touch. They have to agree.
connections.privacyOff: You have connection requests turned off, so nobody can send you one. Change it in Privacy settings.

legal.questions: Questions about this document? Contact the operator of this Trip2World deployment.
legal.englishOnlyTitle: This document is only available in English.
legal.englishOnlyBody: Legal text is not machine-translated here. A mistranslated Terms of Service or Privacy Policy is worse than one you have to read in a second language, because it may not say what it appears to say — and it is the English version that governs. The rest of Trip2World is in your language.
legal.reviewNoticeBody: This document describes how this software actually behaves, but it has not been reviewed by a lawyer and is not legal advice. Have it reviewed against the law where you operate and where your users are, particularly GDPR if you serve the EU/UK.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to start meeting people.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free, and you must be {age} or over.
register.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. This is what other people see.
register.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase works well.
register.birthDateHint: Only ever shown to you. Others see an age range.
register.consent: I am {age} or older and I accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and <guidelines>Community Guidelines</guidelines>.
register.checkEmailSubtitle: One more step before you can start.
register.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
register.checkEmailSpam: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder — the link expires in 24 hours.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to set a new one.
forgot.sentSubtitle: If we found an account, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.sentBody: We sent a link to {email} if an account exists for it. The link expires in one hour and can only be used once.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Make it something you have not used elsewhere.
reset.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase works well.
reset.noTokenSubtitle: Open the link from your email directly.
reset.noTokenBody: The reset link is missing its token. Copying only part of the URL is the usual cause.
reset.doneSubtitle: Every other device has been signed out.
reset.doneBody: For your safety, resetting a password ends every existing session — including anyone else who had access.

verify.workingSubtitle: This will only take a moment.
verify.successBody: You can now start meeting people.
verify.expiredSubtitle: Confirmation links are valid for 24 hours.
verify.expiredBody: Request a new confirmation email and try again.
verify.failedTitle: We could not confirm that link
verify.failedSubtitle: The link may have already been used.
verify.missingBody: That link is incomplete. Open the link from your email directly rather than copying part of it.
verify.resendSent: If that address still needs confirming, a new link is on its way.
